from PIL import Image; import numpy as np
im=np.asarray(Image.open('observations/obs_0169.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B=im[:,:,0],im[:,:,1],im[:,:,2]
px,py=3.452,7.899   # h=180: forward=(0,-1) SOUTH, right=(-1,0) WEST
def bp(u,v,z=0.0):
    D=(1.55-z)*256.0/(v-256); L=D*(u-256)/256.0
    return px-L, py-D, D
print('--- landmark column predictions from this pose ---')
for n,(x,y) in [('blue_vase_1',(-2.45,1.50)),('potted_plant_1',(1.02,2.95)),
                ('cabinet_1',(2.40,3.46)),('dark_table_1',(2.55,1.39)),
                ('stool_1',(-0.85,5.38)),('floor_lamp_1',(-2.45,5.85)),
                ('wooden_chair_1',(-2.83,3.57))]:
    D=py-y; L=px-x
    u=256+256*L/D if D>0 else None
    vb=256+256*1.55/D if D>0 else None
    print('  %-16s D=%.2f u=%s v_base=%s'%(n,D,('%.0f'%u) if u else '-',('%.0f'%vb) if vb else '-'))
print()
brown=(abs(R-117)<28)&(abs(G-64)<26)&(B<60)&((R-B)>50)
blue=(B>180)&(B-R>120)
green=(G-R>25)&(G-B>25)
print('--- brown mask (u,vtop,vbot) ---')
for u in range(256,340,4):
    i=np.where(brown[:,u])[0]
    if len(i)>1: print('  u%3d v %d..%d'%(u,i.min(),i.max()))
print('--- blue mask ---')
for u in range(470,512,4):
    i=np.where(blue[:,u])[0]
    if len(i)>1:
        v=i.max(); x,y,D=bp(u,v); print('  u%3d v %d..%d  base->(%.2f,%.2f) D=%.2f'%(u,i.min(),v,x,y,D))
print('--- green mask ---')
for u in range(330,400,6):
    i=np.where(green[:,u])[0]
    if len(i)>1: print('  u%3d v %d..%d'%(u,i.min(),i.max()))
print('--- dark (33,38,46) upper region: bottom row per column ---')
d=(abs(R-33)<9)&(abs(G-38)<9)&(abs(B-46)<10)
for u in range(180,512,20):
    i=np.where(d[:,u])[0]
    print('  u%3d'%u, (i.min(),i.max()) if len(i)>2 else None)
" 2>/dev/null
